title: Patient 1 before IVIG therapy
treatment_protocol_ch1: The KDs received high-dose IVIG treatment combined with oral aspirin.
extract_protocol_ch1: Venous blood was collected on the 5th days after the onset of fever before IVIG therapy and 24 hours after IVIG therapy and subsidence of fever. PBMCs were isolated by density gradient centrifugation using the Ficoll-Paque medium.
Single-cell capturing and library construction were performed using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell V(D)J Reagent Kits v1.1 (10x Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
